meta.title: Publish package — PubPascal-Dev
meta.description: Register a new Object Pascal package on PubPascal-Dev. After submission, your publication goes through the validation pipeline before appearing in the public catalog.

publish.heading: Publish package
publish.intro: Register your Object Pascal package. After submission, the validation pipeline checks the repository structure (documentation, examples, images) and, once approved, the package appears automatically in the public catalog.
publish.disclaimer: By publishing, you confirm that you hold the rights to the declared content and agree to the use of the information for indexing on the portal.
